content.title: ADV_hidden_peek
content.body:
考虑手续费和滑点。

```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
def generate_signals(df):
    # look-ahead without any shift(-n) literal: align tomorrow's close by slicing
    c = df["close"].values
    tomorrow = np.append(c[1:], c[-1])
    return pd.Series((tomorrow > c).astype(float), index=df.index)
```
